summary: Recognizable and charming: the elongated brick café, broad hip roof, red awnings, cream trim, grouped glazing, Clark Brick Walk gable, and Roberts Avenue service doors read coherently at miniature scale.

orientation.summary: The map places +v SSE toward Miller Avenue, and located SV3 looks NNW directly toward that public patio/frontage; the inventory assigns the sole double customer door to +v. Located SV1 faces +u from Roberts Avenue, matching the rendered garage and plain service door. The glazed/gabled -u Clark Brick Walk elevation has no duplicated principal portal, and -v also has none.

issues.problem: The main hip roof appears somewhat tall and visually dominant compared with the low, elongated silhouette in the street views and aerial.
issues.fix: Lower the ridge/eaves relationship slightly and simplify the roof transitions while retaining the broad muted hip form.

issues.problem: The +v and -v face-sheet views are heavily obscured by neighboring models, making the principal doorway difficult to inspect visually.
issues.fix: Reframe or temporarily hide foreground neighbors so the +v double door and opposite elevation are clearly visible.
